verdict.rationale: Gecko documents a hybrid deployment in which the scanner, S3 storage and all AI inference run inside the customer's own AWS account, and its pricing lists on-prem, self-hosted and private-cloud options. That gives customers real control over where code and scan artifacts live. However, the dashboard and database stay hosted by Gecko, and no explicit region or residency selection is documented. Missing for 10: explicit region/data-residency selection for Gecko-hosted data (dashboard, database), documentation of which regions are supported, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: the scanner, S3 storage, and all AI inference run inside your AWS account. Gecko hosts only the dashboard, database, and scan orchestration.
